title: Cocycle lifting for injective module presheaves without a covering condition
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a category, let $R$ be a presheaf of rings, and let $M$ be an injective object [def-sp-injective-resolutions] in its category of module presheaves [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification]. Let $f_t:U_t\to U$ be a family indexed by a set $T$, with chosen iterated fibre products and index maps $S$ as in [def-weil-pbc-site-cech-complex]. For every $q\geq0$ and cochain $c\in\check C^{q+1}(S,M)$ whose alternating restriction differential is zero, there is a cochain $b\in\check C^q(S,M)$ whose alternating restriction differential is $c$. No topology, covering condition, or sheaf condition is assumed.

source.place: Lemma Tag 03FC (lemma-injective-module-trivial-cech), proof after the use of Tag 03FB, via Tags 03AS, 03F5 and 03AT

proof.text: Form the chain complex $K_n=\bigoplus_{t\in T^{n+1}}R[h_{W_{n,t}}]$ of free representable module presheaves, with the alternating deletion boundary. At every object $V$, group basis elements by their composite $V\to U$. The fibre-product universal property identifies each group with tuples in the corresponding set of lifts. This construction uses the chosen products and index maps of [def-weil-pbc-site-cech-complex] and the module-presheaf category [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification].

An empty lift set contributes a zero complex. For a nonempty lift set, insert a chosen lift as the first coordinate. The contracting homotopy of [lem-weil-pbc-power-set-complex-contractible], with coefficient ring $R(V)$, proves exactness in positive degrees. Direct sums preserve this exactness and module-presheaf exactness is objectwise, so $K$ is exact in positive degrees. This is the argument of Tag 03F5; it does not use a topology or covering condition.

Apply free Yoneda [lem-weil-pbc-free-yoneda-presheaf-module] and the coproduct universal property to identify $\operatorname{Hom}(K_n,M)$ with the degree-$n$ cochains of [def-weil-pbc-site-cech-complex]. Precomposition with each deletion projection is restriction along that projection, so the alternating boundary induces exactly the displayed differential. Thus a cocycle $c$ gives a morphism $K_{q+1}\to M$ killing the image of $K_{q+2}\to K_{q+1}$.

Exactness at $K_{q+1}$ factors this morphism through the image of $K_{q+1}\to K_q$. Injectivity [def-sp-injective-resolutions] extends it along the monomorphism from that image into $K_q$. Equivalently use Mathlib ShortComplex.Exact.descToInjective and comp_descToInjective. Free Yoneda turns the resulting map $K_q\to M$ into $b$ with $d^q b=c$. The degree $q=0$ uses exactness at $1$, never exactness at $0$.

lean.statement: theorem injective_presheaf_module_cech_cocycle_lift {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] (R : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ RingCat.{r}) (M : PresheafOfModules.{s} R) [Injective M] {T : Type w} {U : C} (f : T → C) (hom : ∀ t, f t ⟶ U) (S : SiteCechComplex f hom) (q : ℕ) (c : S.cochains M.presheaf (q + 1)) (hc : S.differentialValue M.presheaf (q + 1) c = 0) : ∃ b : S.cochains M.presheaf q, S.differentialValue M.presheaf q b = c
